Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Countertops, Inc. specializes in the installation and repair of various countertop and surface materials, including granite, quartz, and laminate. We offer custom fabrication, professional installation, and repair services for residential and commercial clients. Our operations include working with both standard and exotic materials, which require adherence to specific installation techniques and safety measures. We prioritize quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring that all our installations meet industry standards.
